newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker buyers sidelined expecting fall.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker buyers sidelined expecting fall.

text.p: Singapore bunker market were steady in quiet trade on Monday with shipowners sidelined on expectations of a fall in cargo prices due to weaker crude prices and lower prices at other regional bunker ports.
"Owners are holding back as they expect prices to come down and prices in Korea have come down," one trader said.
Traders said Singapore is due for a downward correction as South Korea and Rotterdam prices are all lower.
Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $100-$102 per tonne and 180-cst was at $107-$109. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $188-$192 and $200-205 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3093)
